failure_modes.when: 输入 DEM 与影像网格或范围不一致
failure_modes.remedy: 先用 rs:align 把 DEM 与影像对齐到同一网格

failure_modes.when: DEM 与影像坐标系不同
failure_modes.remedy: 对 DEM 或影像做重投影后再执行地形校正

limitations: Self-shadowed pixels (cos_i <= 0, or cos_i + c <= 0 for the C model) and Minnaert-domain violations become NaN NoData.
The empirical C factor requires a usable radiance~illumination regression (|b| >= 1e-6, >= 2 valid pairs); otherwise the operator refuses with a typed error instead of passing data through.
c_correction is also the SCS+C form (Soenen et al. 2005) when c is estimated from the same radiance~illumination regression, as done here.
prerequisites: DEM must be on the same grid as the input (CRS, geotransform, size) — mismatched grids are refused, never resampled.
Solar zenith/azimuth of the scene must be supplied explicitly (import metadata does not carry them yet).
DEM 与影像须覆盖同一区域且波段含太阳角度信息；推荐先 rs:align 统一网格。
capability.summary: 地形辐射校正：利用 DEM 与太阳几何消除坡面光照差异，恢复山地地表的真实反射率。

teaching_use.exercise: 在山区 DEM 上分别执行 C 校正与 SCS 校正，比较阴坡 NDVI 的恢复程度。

description: Topographic correction of reflectance over a co-registered DEM (cosine, C/SCS+C, or Minnaert illumination models).
notes: Two-pass streaming correction (regression + apply); fits are full-scene per band, accumulated in double; bit-exact grade (single-threaded, fixed order).
